# Louise Doublet

Louise Doublet is the current Deputy of [District 7](https://flow.je/elections/district-7) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

Louise Doublet has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/louise-doublet#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 with 63.6% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/louise-doublet-3/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lef0uJkbBrg)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/louise-doublet#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 with 71.9% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/louise-doublet-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U4ZzdQ2ZJKM)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FIq23rngWB0)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/louise-doublet#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 7 with 38.6% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/louise-doublet/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ThCT36ASVu0)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://www.facebook.com/LouiseDoubletJersey/posts/pfbid02b4TBARTNG9cWD3dToAyfQmQzxWwskq6W2LsVsijPUbnQwYzHPYcXnYWwrf7kyMj8l)

Louise Doublet has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 7](https://flow.je/elections/district-7). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/14/deputy-launched-re-election-bid/)\]

Links for Louise Doublet:

- Facebook : [@LouiseDoubletJersey](https://www.facebook.com/LouiseDoubletJersey)
- Twitter : [@loudoublet](https://twitter.com/loudoublet)

## Election History

### 2014 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Saviour No 2](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour-no-2) (2 seats), 15th October 2014.

**Louise Doublet was elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 in 2014**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Kevin Lewis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kevin-lewis)** |  | 727 | 73.2% |
| 2 | **Louise Doublet** |  | 632 | 63.6% |
| 3 | [Maureen Morgan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/maureen-morgan) |  | 285 | 28.7% |

993 ballots (inc. 13 spoilt papers)

2,923 registered voters

= 34% turnout
